label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
Used Kilbarrack Van Co on Saturday 17 October to move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra. It was a two-bed flat, though mostly my own stuff, and the new place was a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift, so it wasn’t the handiest job in the world.

The quote was €340 for up to four hours, with two lads and the van. They got it done in roughly three and a half hours. I’d got a few other quotes that were €450 or more, so price-wise they were comfortably the best value I found. Booking through the website was easy enough and the €50 deposit was paid by Revolut.

They were booked for 9am but didn’t arrive until half 10. To be fair, they did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t sitting there wondering where they were, but it was still an hour and a half sitting on boxes drinking cold coffee. Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards without me asking, which I thought was decent of him and took the sting out of it. It wasn’t a disaster for me because I’d a bit of flexibility on the day, but if you’re working around a strict landlord handover, keys being collected or anything else with a hard deadline, I’d either allow plenty of breathing room or make that deadline very clear when booking.

Once they started, they were quick and worked hard. The stairs at the new place were no joke and there was no complaining or messing about. The couch looked like it had absolutely no chance of getting around the turn on the third floor, but the younger lad produced an Allen key from his pocket, took the legs off and had it straight in. They also put my bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want, both of which I really appreciated after a long day of moving.

The one bad bit was my brass floor lamp. The base got chipped during the move. Everything else seemed to be wrapped in blankets, but the lamp wasn’t. It’s only a small chip physically, but it was my nanny’s lamp, so I was a bit gutted about that one. It wouldn’t stop me using them again, but it’s worth mentioning because it’s the sort of thing I’d want to know myself. Wrap the lamps, lads!

So, four stars from me. Not a perfect move: they were late and the lamp got damaged. But the price was very fair, the discount for being late was handled well, and once they arrived they did a tough job efficiently and were helpful beyond the basics. I’d genuinely use them again. If you’re moving and have a little flexibility with timing, they’re well worth getting a quote from — just point out anything fragile or sentimental beforehand and make sure it’s wrapped.
